			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_dir_pending }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_dir_pending
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_d_key = 9 } }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_d_tier = 2 } }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_d_days = 270 } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_d_reported
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_d_ai_done
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_d_delivered
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_d_komsomol
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_dir_plan = global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan } } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_dir_plan = global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_dir_count = 0 } } }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_dir_count = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_UNI_start_directive = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_directive_active
			if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } COLDWAR_UNI_ai_floor_directive = yes }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.21 days = 1 }
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_UNI_directive_issued_tt
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_UNI.20.k
		trigger = {
			any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_dir_pending OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_target_active } always = yes } }
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 0
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_dir_pending }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_dir_pending
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_d_key = 11 } }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_d_tier = 2 } }
			hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_d_days = 270 } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_d_reported
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_d_ai_done
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_d_delivered
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_d_komsomol
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_dir_plan = global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan } } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_dir_plan = global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_dir_count = 0 } } }
			hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_dir_count = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_UNI_start_directive = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_directive_active
			if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } COLDWAR_UNI_ai_floor_directive = yes }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.21 days = 1 }
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_UNI_directive_issued_tt
	}
}
